title: redact.redact leaves Authorization header credentials, a URL's user:password@ password and a private key block's body in text
goal: redact.redact replaces with the secret placeholder the credential after Authorization: Bearer and Authorization: Basic, the password of a URL's user:password@ part (the user kept) and a whole -----BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY----- block through its END line, whatever the value's length or entropy; a second pass changes nothing and the ordinary sample stays unchanged; the planted input of test_redact.py's first test holds each of these shapes

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import redact as R;v='Fake'+'Pass12345x';b='ZmFr'+'ZTpmYWtl';body='MIIfake'+'FAKEfake';pem='-----BEGIN '+'PRIVATE KEY-----'+chr(10)+body+chr(10)+'-----END PRIVATE KEY-----';cases={'bearer':('Authorization: Bearer '+v,v),'basic':('Authorization: Basic '+b,b),'userinfo':('postgres://fakeuser:'+v+'@db.example.com:5432/app',v),'key body':(pem,body)};left=[n for n,(t,x) in cases.items() if x in R.redact(t)];print('left:',left);sys.exit(1 if left else 0)

import sys;t=open('_tools/test_redact.py',encoding='utf-8').read();need=['Bearer','Basic ','END ','PRIVATE'];miss=[n for n in need if n not in t];print('missing in test_redact.py:',miss);sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

gates.question: Where do the header, URL user:password@ and key-block shapes live: in redact.py's rules only, leaving the committed-file leak scan's shape list (kbcommon) as it is, or in that shared list too? The plan probe found about 241 'Bearer|Basic <word>' and 16 'scheme://user:pass@' matches in tracked files today (docs, snapshots, 'Basic Workflow'), which a shared shape would flag in the suite and the sync gate.
Does a private key block with no END line (cut off) lose its body too, or only its BEGIN line as before?
options: whole block with an END line only
cut-off block to the end of the text too
gates.recommendation: whole block with an END line only
gates.answer: cut-off block to the end of the text too

notes: Found by the SP-yyjwfjtc plan probe on origin/main b97cd6ebf: Authorization: Bearer v passes unless v is 20+ characters of high entropy (the TOKEN rule), Basic likewise (a long base64 credential is caught, a short one is not), postgres://user:pass@host keeps the password, and a private key block keeps its body (only the BEGIN line, a kbcommon.SECRETS shape, is replaced). Repro on the base: exit 1, left: bearer, basic, userinfo, key body. Separate from BG-w5d2mvwz (assignment forms) and after it, since both change redact.py and test_redact.py. Check 0 (tests.py -k redact_replaces_every_class) passes before the work on purpose: it pins idempotence and the ordinary sample under the wider rules; the repro and check 1 fail until the work. Gate g1 answered by the orchestrator acting as operator (2026-10-17) against the worker recommendation: a cut-off key body left in text is the risky outcome the sprint goal and the operator secrets policy rule out, so the conservative option (more redaction) was taken.
